camel_example: aliyun eflo-controller SendFile --region cn-hangzhou --NodeIdList '["e01-cn-zvp2tgykr08"]' --Content '#!/bin/bash echo "Current User is :" echo $(ps | grep "$$" | awk '"'"'{print $2}'"'"') -------- oss://bucketName/objectName' --TargetDir '/home' --Name 'file.txt'
description_en: Delivers a remote file to one or more Lingjun nodes
description_zh: 一台或多台灵骏机器下发远程文件
kebab_example: aliyun eflo-controller send-file --name file.txt --target-dir /home --content '#!/bin/bash echo "Current User is :" echo $(ps | grep "$$" | awk '"'"'{print $2}'"'"') -------- oss://bucketName/objectName' --node-id-list e01-cn-zvp2tgykr08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendFile

parameters.help_en: The file name. The name supports all character sets and can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 文件名称。支持全字符集，长度不得超过255个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description. The description supports all character sets and can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 描述信息。支持全字符集，长度不得超过512个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The target folder on the Lingjun nodes to which the file is delivered. If the folder does not exist, automatic creation is performed
parameters.help_zh: 文件下发目标灵骏节点中的目录。如不存在则会自动创建
parameters.name: target_dir

parameters.help_en:
The content type of the file. Valid values:
PlainText: plain text.
Base64: Base64-encoded text.
Default value: PlainText
parameters.help_zh:
文件内容类型。

PlainText：普通文本。
Base64：Base64编码。
默认值为PlainText
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.example: #!/bin/bash echo "Current User is :" echo $(ps | grep "$$" | awk '{print $2}') -------- oss://bucketName/objectName
parameters.help_en:
The file content. The size of the file content cannot exceed 32 KB after Base64 encoding.
If the ContentType parameter is set to PlainText, this field contains plain text.
If the ContentType parameter is set to Base64, this field contains Base64-encoded text
parameters.help_zh:
文件内容。文件内容在Base64编码后，大小不能超过32 KB。

当`ContentType`参数为`PlainText`时，该字段为明文格式的普通文本。
当`ContentType`参数为`Base64`时，该字段为Base64编码的文本
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en:
The file permissions. This parameter takes effect only on Linux instances. The setting method is the same as that of the chmod command.
Default value: 0644, which indicates that the owner has read and write permissions, and the group and others have read-only permissions
parameters.help_zh:
文件的权限。只对Linux实例生效，设置方式与chmod命令相同。

默认值为0644，表示用户具有读写权限，用户组和其它用户具有只读权限
parameters.name: file_mode

parameters.help_en: The file owner. This parameter takes effect only on Linux instances. Default value: root
parameters.help_zh: 文件的用户。只对Linux实例生效，默认为root
parameters.name: file_owner

parameters.help_en:
The file group. This parameter takes effect only on Linux instances. Default value: root. The value can be up to 64 characters in length.
Note
When you use a different group, make sure that the group exists on the instance
parameters.help_zh:
文件的用户组。只对Linux实例生效，默认为root。长度不得超过64个字符。

说明
使用其他用户组时，请确保实例中存在该用户组
parameters.name: file_group

parameters.help_en: The list of node IDs. The node IDs must belong to created Lingjun nodes. You can call the ListClusterNodes or ListFreeNodes operation to query the node IDs
parameters.help_zh: 节点列表。节点 ID 需为已创建的灵骏节点，可通过 ListClusterNodes 或 ListFreeNodes 查询获取
parameters.name: node_id_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite the file if a file with the same name already exists in the target directory. Valid values:
true: Overwrites the file.
false: Does not overwrite the file.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
如果同名文件在目标目录已存在，是否覆盖文件。
true：覆盖。
false：不覆盖。

默认值为false
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for delivering the file. Unit: seconds.
A timeout occurs if the file cannot be delivered due to process issues, missing modules, or a missing Cloud Assistant Agent.
If the specified timeout period is less than 10 seconds, the system automatically sets it to 10 seconds to ensure successful delivery.
Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
下发文件的超时时间。单位：秒。

当因为进程原因、缺失模块、缺失云助手Agent等原因无法下发文件时，会出现超时现象。
当设置的超时时间小于10秒时，为确保下发成功，系统会将超时时间自动设置为10秒。

默认值为60
parameters.name: timeout
